Question Choices: Fill In the fraction 5/8, the denominator is __
Hints: The denominator is the bottom number
Solution: The denominator is the bottom number, which is 8 in 5/8.

Question Choices: Select which fraction is larger 3/8 or 5/8 ~~3/8 | 5/8~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: Both fractions count eighths. Since 5 > 3, 5/8 is larger than 3/8.

Question Choices: Select which fraction is smaller 4/5 or 4/7 ~~4/5 | 4/7~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Sevenths are smaller than fifths of the same whole. Taking four pieces gives 4/7 < 4/5. Select 4/7.

Question Choices: Select which symbol should I put in the blanks 2/5 __ 4/5 ~~< | > | =~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: Both fractions count fifths. Since 2 < 4, 2/5 < 4/5. Select <.

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE of the following statement 2/4 = 4/8 ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: Draw both fractions or imagine folding the shape.
Solution: TRUE. Multiplying numerator and denominator of 2/4 by 2 gives 4/8. Both fractions equal 1/2.
